item.title: Jewish teens from 60 nations fill Nassau Coliseum for CTeen Summit Finale
item.description: Jewish teenagers from more than 60 countries filled Nassau Coliseum on Sunday, waving flags, singing and cheering as they marked the close of the 18th annual CTeen International Summit in what organizers called the largest gathering of Jewish teens in the world. item.title: Correction
item.description: The architect behind the redesign of the Americana was misidentified in a story published by Nassau Tomorrow. The correct architect was Peter Marino.

item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement is renting office space in Woodbury for up to 40 attorneys, according to Aresco Management, which owns the four-story building. item.title: Flowers, fundraising, fashion keep Americana full
item.description: Americana Manhasset, any day of the week, is full of beautiful objects, from clothing to jewelry to other items, but back in October, it took luxury to another level.
